dedupe_keys.name: california hcai hospital annual utilization and annual financial data

description: California's Department of Health Care Access and Information publishes the annual reports that every licensed hospital in the state files on its utilisation and finances. The utilisation data give bed classifications, occupancy rates, discharges and patient days by bed type, births, operating rooms, surgeries, cardiovascular procedures and the level of licensed emergency medical services; the financial data give services capacity, utilisation and revenue by payer, expenses, balance sheets, income statements, financial ratios and labour. The producer is the Department of Health Care Access and Information (formerly OSHPD), published on the California Health and Human Services Open Data Portal. Coverage is all licensed hospitals in California, annually, with editions from the 2010s to a preliminary 2025 file. Files are Excel workbooks and CSV with pivot tables and reporting instructions, free without registration, under the portal's terms of use; no licence is named. Caveats: the financial files are a selected subset of a larger data set, hospital fiscal years differ (calendar-year groupings are provided), preliminary files are revised, and identifiers differ from those of the public health department. Simulation uses: occupancy and emergency department capacity baselines for surge, evacuation and resilience studies of hospitals under earthquakes, wildfires and heat, and financial parameters for recovery analysis. Related records: the California licensed facilities and beds data (data-california-licensed-healthcare-facilities-and-beds) and HCRIS cost reports (data-cms-hcris-cost-reports).
